items.exampleEn: Some streets in the old part of the city still look medieval.
items.exampleZh: 老城區有些街道看起來仍然像中世紀的樣子。

items.exampleEn: Many old stories teach children about morality.
items.exampleZh: 很多古老的故事都在教孩子道德。

items.exampleEn: The family put fruit and flowers on the altar for the New Year.
items.exampleZh: 過年時，這家人在供桌上擺了水果和鮮花。

items.exampleEn: The city is culturally rich, with many museums and theaters.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市文化很豐富，有許多博物館和劇院。

items.exampleEn: The building is no longer used as a place of worship.
items.exampleZh: 這棟建築已經不再作為禮拜的場所了。

items.exampleEn: Scientists found a two-thousand-year-old tomb under a farm.
items.exampleZh: 科學家在一座農場底下發現了一座兩千年前的古墓。

items.exampleEn: Lying to a friend is morally wrong, even if it seems small.
items.exampleZh: 對朋友說謊在道德上是錯的，就算看起來是小事也一樣。

items.exampleEn: In some cultures, a special rite is held when a baby is one month old.
items.exampleZh: 在某些文化中，嬰兒滿月時會舉行特別的儀式。

items.sentenceEn: This bridge was built in medieval times and is still used today.
items.sentenceZh: 這座橋建於中世紀，至今仍在使用。

items.audioEn: Visitors can take photos inside the temple, but not near the altar.
items.audioZh: 遊客可以在廟裡拍照，但不能在祭壇附近拍。
items.questionZh: 遊客在廟裡哪裡不能拍照？

items.sentenceEn: The ancient tomb was full of gold coins and old pots.
items.sentenceZh: 那座古墓裡滿是金幣和古老的陶罐。

items.sentenceEn: Morally, I think we should return the money we found.
items.sentenceZh: 從道德上來說，我認為我們應該把撿到的錢還回去。

items.stemEn: The two neighboring towns are ____ very similar: they share the same festivals and food.
items.stemZh: 這兩個相鄰的小鎮在文化上非常相似：他們有相同的節慶和食物。

items.stemEn: The wedding included an old ____ in which the couple drank tea from the same cup.
items.stemZh: 婚禮中有一個古老的儀式，新人用同一個杯子喝茶。

items.passageEn: Last summer, our class went on an excursion to a medieval town in Italy. Our guide showed us a small church where people still come for worship every Sunday. Inside, there was a beautiful stone altar and the tomb of a rich family from seven hundred years ago. The guide explained that the town once held an unusual rite every spring: young people walked around the town walls at night to show they were adults. Culturally, the town has changed very little. Later, our teacher asked us a hard question about morality: was it morally right for rich families to build such grand tombs while many people were poor?
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們班到義大利的一個中世紀小鎮校外教學。導遊帶我們看一座小教堂，到現在每個星期天仍有人來這裡做禮拜。教堂裡有一座美麗的石造祭壇，還有一個七百年前富有家族的墳墓。導遊說，這個小鎮以前每年春天都有一個不尋常的儀式：年輕人晚上繞著城牆走，表示自己已經成年。在文化上，這個小鎮幾乎沒什麼改變。後來，老師問了我們一個關於道德的難題：在很多人都很窮的時候，有錢人家蓋這麼豪華的墳墓，在道德上是對的嗎？

questions.questionZh: 以前小鎮每年春天有什麼儀式？
options: 有錢人家為窮人準備大餐
全鎮的人一起到教堂做禮拜

questions.questionZh: 老師問了學生什麼問題？
options: 教堂裡的祭壇是誰做的
他們最喜歡哪一間教堂

items.promptZh: 這部電影探討道德與法律之間的差異。
referenceEn: This film explores the difference between morality and the law.
This movie is about the difference between morality and the law.
rubricZh: 「探討」可寫，例如 explores、looks at、is about 等
「之間的差異」可寫，例如 the difference between … and … 等

items.promptZh: 這本書描寫中世紀農民的日常生活。
referenceEn: This book describes the daily life of medieval farmers.
This book is about the everyday lives of farmers in medieval times.
rubricZh: medieval 放名詞前（例如 medieval farmers、in medieval times 等）
「描寫」可寫，例如 describes、is about 等
「日常生活」可寫，例如 daily life、everyday lives 等，單複數不扣分
